text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be having fun, Creek-san. Did 
something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
What do you think it is~? Try to guess! 
I'll give you something nice if you do~.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Inexperienced as I am, I haven't the 
faintest idea.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even so, considering how overjoyed you 
are, something truly wonderful must have 
happened.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the correct answer is: Yaeno-chan's 
birthday~. Even if you got it wrong, I'll 
still give you a present♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I recognize you as a rival that I must 
defeat.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
With an unquenchable fighting spirit and 
all one's heart and soul— to strike them 
down using the body and mind one has 
forged. That is what I constantly keep in 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Creek-san, are you really planning to 
celebrate the birthday of someone like 
that with joy?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Of course♪ I'll prepare lots of cake and 
delicious food, so eat up plenty and grow 
big and strong~♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"! I see. You are telling me to become 
worthy of battle. Those expectations... I 
shall certainly fulfill them!"
